alt: A short film with no voice, with music. Mint green background. Cella wears a small red crown and stands on top of a very tall, thin indigo column inside a white circle of light, looking down to her left. A second Cella of the same size stands on the floor at the left with a cardboard phone at her side. Big text at the top: Not avoidant. Just very, very hard to reach. The small Cella lifts the phone and a speech bubble that says ring floats up beside the column, then goes flat. A second bubble rises higher and goes flat. The crowned Cella glances down at it and straightens her crown. A third bubble rises almost to her and stops still, a hand's width away; she lowers her eyelids. The bubble sinks. The small Cella puts the phone on the floor and sits down. Both look at the camera: Hard to reach?
envio: the friend who answers once a week
